semantic_review.scope: All prose and explanatory entries; repeated identical executable examples verified mechanically. This is an AI-assisted complete semantic review.

operations.resolution: Corrected nonexistent postgresql.datadir to postgresql.data_dir in generated configuration and fallback descriptions.
Corrected IP resolution attribution: gethostname returns the host name; getaddrinfo resolves it. All seven address descriptions synchronized.
Corrected SRV example query suffix to example.org, matching the configured domain.
Corrected binary override key pgcontroldata to pg_controldata; pgcommand uses the binary command name as the bin_name lookup key.
Corrected HTTP OPTION to OPTIONS for health checks. Chinese already used the supported method and remains synchronized.
Corrected list --format descriptions copied from history: the output describes cluster members, not event history.
Replaced unsupported strict-mode last-voter retention and reserved-placeholder behavior with exact v4.1.5 wildcard behavior, explicitly scoped to priority-based synchronous_mode: on.
Removed unsupported reserved-name restriction for PATRONI_NAME and YAML name. Exact v4.1.5 schema accepts name as str; tagged ENV/YAML documentation only requires cluster uniqueness.

releases.decision: Patroni could stop during replica bootstrap while tools kept running.
releases.locator: shutdown(), line 2064 AsyncExecutor.cancel(); compare v4.0.4 shutdown()

releases.decision: Shutdown checkpoint receipt, rather than shut down checking.
Revision-mismatch cache invalidation applies when the update fails.
postgresql.bin_name.* are configuration settings; PATRONI_POSTGRESQL_BIN_* are environment variables.
The actual queried view is pg_replication_slots, with temporary slots excluded.
The database/user literal is lowercase postgres.
gPRC is a protocol-name typo; use gRPC.
The strict-mode GRANT stall is due to no synchronous standbys being available.
releases.locator: strict mode picked=None uses wildcard, lines 384-386; bootstrap GRANT uses local synchronous_commit lines 307-312

releases.decision: /health returns status 200 only if PostgreSQL is running; the status number was omitted.

releases.locator: controldata(), lines 1054-1067; PostgreSQL10 get_controlfile() reads global/pg_control, lines 47-62
signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, ...), line 175; earliest retained v1.2.x tag
